blocks.text: Explore the jungle with step-by-step instructions and demonstrations on how to find water, start a fire, and obtain salt. Your instructor will teach you to recognize types of vegetables, fruits, set traps, build shelters, and administer first aid in the jungle. You will also be introduced to a new activity: tree climbing with bound legs. Afterward, you'll have lunch consisting of chicken, fish, cassava, lemon, and fruits. After lunch, you'll put your newly acquired skills into action. In the evening, dinner will be served in the jungle. Nighttime will feature lectures on Amazon legends, jungle knowledge, and local traditions. You'll spend the night in hammocks with mosquito nets tied between trees.
